svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Eleven blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases, metric, parts, transitional products, interior products, geometric products, norms, properties, measures, projections and motion operators. Each block takes its inputs from other blocks on a top row, in one box for each block that they come from, and builds downward. Each box takes its own line from each box that it uses, and holds a symbol. Each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table. Faded lines are routes that the code does not take, and faded boxes are operators with no table.
